headers: Estimates are minimums, but not guaranteed minimums, and the contract cost can increase so long as the unit costs remain the same and the increased funds are appropriated in the budget. Line item entries shall prevail over sum total entries.  When discrepancies exist between unit prices and corresponding extended prices, unit prices shall prevail.
sample: Prices must be submitted on the prescribed form and all blank spaces on the form for prices must be filled in, (in ink or typewritten for paper submittals). Failure to fill in all blank spaces shall cause the bid to be deemed non responsive and it will not be considered in determining the lowest responsible bidder

As part of the requirement to establish the responsibility of the Bidder, the City of El Paso may perform a price analysis to determine the reasonableness of the price(s) at which the supplies and/or services are Bid. Prices that are significantly lower than the mean of all bids and that appear to be unreasonably low may be determined to be evidence of non-responsibility, and cause the Bid to be rejected and not considered in determining the lowest responsible bidder.
